p4_sign.why: a_e0_n0.py 计算 10*log10(p_after/p_before)，负值表示损失；契约与验收器判 peak_loss_db <= 0.1。照抄 peak_retention_db 会让 P4 永远通过

phase_unit.equality: array and JSON must agree to 1e-6 ns; cluster-internal |difference| <= 0.1 ns
phase_unit.why: a_e0_n0.align_spectra uses exp(+1j*2*pi*f*shift_s); N7 judges cluster spread in ns

p1_expansion.rule: xcluster_supp_db[f][b] = value of the b-th group in that cluster's prereg held_out order (not lexicographic, not group-name sort)
p1_expansion.why: prototype p1 values are fold-major flat [v0:2, v2:4, ...]; lexical order puts data10 before data2

array_axes.held_out_index: 0,1 in the cluster's prereg held_out order
array_axes.channel_order: rx63: the 63 valid channels, in the same order as the valid_rx mask
array_axes.note: these arrays are not part of the E0-N0-1 35-item contract; they are required by PREREG-CHG-2 §8 for C8' / P1 recomputation, so their axes are frozen here

arm_metrics_pool.rule: n0.arm_metrics[*].air_loo_supp_db is the P2 ten-fold row, never the P1 five-fold row
arm_metrics_pool.why: both are length 10; swapping keeps the type but changes the experiment

method_scope.why: ACCEPT-3 identity guard rejects packages whose method_scope is not this frozen literal

coherence.inputs: z_g(f) = x_g(ref_pos, f): calibrated spectrum of group g after applying its registered shift_s; h = the other group of g's prereg cluster
coherence.source: solutions/A/a_e0_n0_phase.py::coherence_table on stack built by run_synthetic (calibrate_pool -> align_spectra)
coherence.aligned_rule: aligned_g := (rho_g >= rho_min); aligned=false requires a non-empty reason

d1_min_abs_inner.inputs: T, D1 = full-pool rank-2 basis from build_rank2_basis(stack); non-degenerate means ||D1(f)|| > 1e-12 * ||T(f)||
d1_min_abs_inner.expected: 0.0 to 1e-15 for a correct Gram-Schmidt; exactly 0.0 is the expected value, not a placeholder
d1_min_abs_inner.pass: d1_rank == 2 implies 0.0 <= d1_min_abs_inner <= 1e-6; d1_rank == 1 implies d1_min_abs_inner == 0.0
d1_min_abs_inner.degenerate_all: if every bin is degenerate, d1_rank := 1 and d1_min_abs_inner := 0.0

extra_diagnostics.d1_max_abs_inner: same quantity maximized over non-degenerate frequencies; recorded in the phase evidence JSON for audit (not in the E0-N0-1 contract)
extra_diagnostics.d1_median_abs_inner: median of the same quantity; recorded in the phase evidence JSON
extra_diagnostics.sigma2_over_sigma1_median: second/first singular-value ratio median; mode-quality diagnostic, not a gate

gates.note: copied for traceability only; on conflict the frozen prereg JSON wins

outputs.hash_rule: text files are SHA256 over LF-normalized bytes (git blob semantics); .npz is raw bytes

anchors.implementation_sha_policy: resolved at runtime from git HEAD and recorded in results.implementation_sha / results.n0.registration.implementation_sha; not embedded here to avoid a self-referential commit hash
anchors.n0_config_sha256_policy: sha256_file_lf(n0_config.json), recorded in results.n0_config_sha256 and results.n0.registration.n0_config_sha256
